Description: Ends the script with exit code 1, signalling an error
Makes the variable an integer, so its value is treated as a number
Adds a value to what the variable already holds
List of valid options, stored in arg; a ":" after a letter means that option takes a value, which ends up in $OPTARG
Example: while getopts "m:h" arg; do case $arg in m) name=$OPTARG;; h) help;; esac; done

Description: Checks whether two numbers are equal
Defines a pattern inside case and the block to run if it matches; ;; closes that block
Example: case $arg in m) echo "option m";; esac

Description: Repeats the block while the condition inside the brackets is true
Example: while [ -f file.gz ]; do gunzip file.gz; done

Description: Reads input line by line and runs the block for each line
Example: cat list.txt | while read line; do echo $line; done

Description: Goes through the items of a list one by one and runs the block for each
Example: for line in $(cat list.txt); do echo $line; done

Description: Defines the ctrl_c function that runs when trap catches Ctrl+C
Catches the Ctrl+C signal and runs the ctrl_c function instead of stopping the script
Runs a command with a 1-second limit; if it doesn't finish, it's cancelled
Creates a temporary folder instead of a file, with a unique name
Silent mode: hides the progress bar and error messages
Sets the request's HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT...)
